build_skipinit_resnet_model: build a SkipInit_ResNet model with ResNet50 variant for image classification with stochastic depth
run_skipinit_resnet_forward: run a forward pass through SkipInit_ResNet to get logits and optional training metrics
count_skipinit_resnet_flops: count the FLOPs of a SkipInit_ResNet model given input height and width dimensions
